name: What are the benefits of building an attached ADU?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of building an attached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building an attached ADU offers several advantages. It can significantly increase property value and generate rental income, providing a steady revenue stream. For multi-generational families, it offers independent living for aging parents or adult children while keeping them close. Attached ADUs can also serve as a dedicated home office, a guest suite, or a private space for caregivers, enhancing the functionality and flexibility of your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include increased property value, rental income potential, flexible living arrangements for family, or additional functional space like a home office.
